about.track: London, Anglija (id london): a 1.9 km city lap through the centre, clockwise (no real race here: the direction chosen for the views, the clock tower ahead along the embankment): the start on Whitehall (northbound), right at Charing Cross by Trafalgar Square, down the avenue to the Thames, south along the embankment, right at Westminster Bridge along Bridge Street and right at Parliament Square back onto Parliament Street and Whitehall; generic buildings only (docs/nove-proge-1-0.md)
about.frame: metres; origin = the start line (lat0, lon0: the first point of the route); x east, z south; x = (lon - lon0) * N cos(lat0), z = -(lat - lat0) * M (WGS84 radii at lat0)
about.line: the centre line every 5.001 m from the start line round the lap (closed; the last point joins the first): OSM's polyline every 1 m, a Gaussian of sigma 3 m (the corners rounded), resampled
about.h: the road's height at each point of line (m above sea level, 0.1 m): the ground model across the road (median of 5 samples, -8..8 m), the bridges straight from bank to bank, dips under 60 m filled, a 35 m median, sigma 15 m, grades at most 12 %, sigma 5 m
about.hRaw: the ground model under each point of line before the smoothing (m, 0.1 m)
about.ways: [s0, s1, road name (geographic names only), OSM highway, lanes, width, oneway today, surface, maxspeed, bridge]: the route's OSM ways in driving order (s in m from the start line)
about.bends: [s of the apex, radius m, side (1 right, -1 left), turn deg]: the bends of line with a radius under 60 m
about.bld: [x, z, length, width, angle (rad, the long side from +x towards +z), height (m, 0 = not in OSM), kind, s, d (m, + right of the travel direction)]: the buildings with any part within 150 m (OSM); kinds: 0 house / unknown, 1 church / chapel, 2 tower, 3 castle, 4 shed / garage / kiosk, 5 commercial / hotel / industrial, 6 public / station / school, 7 greenhouse, 8 ruin, 9 block of flats
about.bldOutline: [index in bld, [x, z, ...]]: the outline of the buildings that are not a rectangle
about.trees: [x, z, kind]: single trees (OSM) within 60 m; kind p pine, c cypress, o olive, m palm, b broadleaved, '' unknown
about.walls: [barrier (OSM: wall, retaining_wall, fence, guard_rail, hedge ...), height (0 = untagged), wall / material, [x, z, ...]]: within 30 m
about.coast: [x, z, ...]: the coastline within 400 m (OSM: the land on the left of the way's direction, the sea on the right)
about.cliffs: [x, z, ...]: cliffs within 300 m (OSM: the lower side on the right)
about.lakes: [water (OSM water=: lake, river, pond ...), name (geographic), closed (0: a ring cut off where the data ends), [x, z, ...]]: lakes and rivers as areas within 300 m
about.water: [waterway, name (geographic), culvert / tunnel, [x, z, ...]]: streams within 300 m
about.rail: [railway (rail, funicular ...), bridge, tunnel, [x, z, ...]]: within 200 m
about.roads: [highway, lanes, width, 1 bridge / 2 tunnel, layer, surface, name (geographic), par (1: a carriageway alongside the route), [x, z, ...]]: other roads and paths within 60 m (clipped to 80 m)
about.side: [s, side (1 right, -1 left), angle (deg from the travel direction, + right), highway, lanes or width, oneway, name (geographic), [x, z, ...] the first 60 m from the junction]: every road and path that meets the route
about.onRoad: [s, kind (crossing, traffic_signals, stop, give_way, calming), detail]
about.stops: [s, side, distance, shelter]: bus stops within 30 m
about.bridges: [s0, s1]: the route on a bridge
about.over: [s, rail / road, kind]: a railway or road on a bridge over the route
about.landmarks: [label (game, Slovenian), English, kind, s, d, [x, z, ...] outline]: s and d of its nearest point
about.places: [label, x, z, s, d of OSM's place from the road]: the HUD's places
about.grids: PNG files next to this one (see each entry)
about.sources: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0; the derived data here under the ODbL 1.0), downloaded 2026-11-08; Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved); ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0); Meta and World Resources Institute, High Resolution Canopy Height Maps (CC BY 4.0)
about.tools: tools/proga-podatki.py with tools/london/config.json (see the tool's header)

dem.enc: uint16 (h + 100) * 10, h in m above sea level; row 0 = z0 (north), col 0 = x0 (west)
dem.what: ground: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 less 0.8 x the canopy (Meta / WRI) and 0.8 x the buildings (OSM), bilinear

far.what: surface (Copernicus DEM GLO-30 as it is: the hills with their woods and the town as seen from afar), 0 = sea

lc.enc: uint8 ESA WorldCover class: 10 trees, 20 shrubs, 30 grass, 40 crops, 50 built-up, 60 bare / sparse, 80 water, 90 wetland; 0 = farther than 300 m from the road

lu.enc: uint8 OSM land use: 1 residential, 2 commercial / industrial / railway, 3 fields, 4 meadow / grass, 5 vineyard, 6 olive grove, 7 orchard, 8 scrub (macchia), 9 forest, 10 park / garden / pitch / cemetery, 11 bare rock / quarry, 12 beach, 13 water, 14 parking / square; 0 = none / farther than 300 m

chm.enc: uint8 canopy height in m (Meta / WRI 1 m map, the mean over each 10 m cell); 0 = none / farther than 300 m
